$comment: MANDELA — PowerSync sync rules (one file, deployed to each school's PowerSync instance). Token claims come from better-auth JWTs minted by the school API: { role, user_id, guardian_id, staff_id }. Every bucket is role-scoped so a phone in a 500,000-learner school syncs hundreds of rows, never millions.

select.where: id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id)

buckets.$comment: GUARDIAN: money for their children only (balance math happens on device)

select.where: learner_id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id)
learner_id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id) AND state = 'confirmed'
learner_id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id) AND day > now() - interval '90 days'
published AND learner_id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id)

buckets.$comment: TEACHER: their classes' learners + registers (offline marking)

select.where: class_id IN (SELECT id FROM class WHERE code = ANY (SELECT unnest(classes) FROM staff WHERE id = token_parameters.staff_id))

day > now() - interval '60 days' AND learner_id IN (SELECT id FROM learner WHERE class_id IN (SELECT id FROM class WHERE code = ANY (SELECT unnest(classes) FROM staff WHERE id = token_parameters.staff_id)))

buckets.$comment: TEACHER + GUARDIAN: homework for their classes/children

select.where: CASE WHEN token_parameters.role = 'teacher' THEN class_id IN (SELECT id FROM class WHERE code = ANY (SELECT unnest(classes) FROM staff WHERE id = token_parameters.staff_id)) ELSE class_id IN (SELECT class_id FROM learner WHERE id IN (SELECT learner_id FROM learner_guardian WHERE guardian_id = token_parameters.guardian_id)) END

buckets.$comment: COUNTER: active library copies (issue/return by scan works offline)

select.where: with_learner IS NOT NULL OR true

buckets.$comment: BURSAR/PRINCIPAL: dashboard aggregates come from the API (materialized views), NOT raw sync — phones never download school-wide ledgers

select.$comment: read-only exposure of the materialized view via API-published snapshot table
